lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling, this is the practice's digital assistant, just to let you know, this call's recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh, hi. Um, yeah, I've been having some knee pain, been going on a couple of weeks now, and I was hoping to get seen this week if possible?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Sorry to hear that. Let me have a look… okay, so this week I've got Wednesday at half ten in the morning, or Thursday at three in the afternoon. Either of those work?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thursday at three's better for me, yeah.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Great, I'll pop you in for Thursday at three. Can I take your full name, please?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's Priya Nair. P-R-I-Y-A, Nair, N-A-I-R.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Priya Nair, got it. And a contact number for you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, it's o-seven-seven-double-o, sorry, hang on, o-seven-seven-zero-zero, nine-double-o, one-two-three.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: No worries, let me read that back: o-seven-seven-zero-zero-nine-zero-zero-one-two-three. Is that right?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Perfect. So that's Thursday at three, under Priya Nair, for the knee. You'll get a text confirmation in the next few minutes with the details. Is there anything else I can help with?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, I think that's everything. Thank you.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: No problem at all. Thanks for calling, Priya, take care, and we'll see you Thursday.
